snippet.title: Stampers – Season One Trailer | Free Playtest on itch.io
snippet.description:
Six against six in hand-built warplanes. A roaring crowd. A live commentary booth. The most kills wins.

Stampers Season One is live – play the free playtest now:
https://printandplaycreative.itch.io/stampers

Pick your airframe – the agile Sparrow, the versatile Bramble or the heavy Mammoth – then build it from over 2,700 hardware configurations and paint it with whole-airplane liveries and nose art.

Take it into 6v6 online dogfights where wings come off, engines burn and airplanes break apart where they’re hit. Bomb the enemy foundry while it stamps out new airplanes, collide mid-air, and let the booth call every kill.

• 6v6 online Quick Match, with bots filling empty seats
• LAN play with friends, and offline practice against bots
• Mouse and keyboard or gamepad
• Windows

Made by Print and Play Creative.

#Stampers #IndieGame #Dogfight #Multiplayer #GameTrailer
